// diagnostic

E3213

`{abi}` is not available on this target.

What

`{abi}` is not available on this target.

Why

Native calling conventions are restricted by operating system and architecture (e.g. `stdcall`/`cdecl`/`fastcall` are Windows x86 only; `win64` is Windows x86-64; `sysv64` is non-Windows x86-64).

Fix

use the default C ABI or `system` for portable declarations.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3213: tests/ui/cffi_abi_target_invalid.stderr.

Error [E3213]: `stdcall` is not available on this target
  --> tests/ui/cffi_abi_target_invalid.jet:4:10
    |
  4 |     #ABI(stdcall) fn ping(x: I32) I32 = "ping"
    |          ^^^^^^^
 Why: native calling conventions are restricted by operating system and architecture
 Fix: use the default C ABI or `system` for portable declarations
